newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Louis Dreyfus Citrus seeks Florida acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Louis Dreyfus Citrus seeks Florida acquisitions.

text.p: Louis Dreyfus Citrus SA, the world's third-largest orange juice producer, is seeking acquisitions in Florida, company officials said.
The officials, who asked to remain anonymous, said a big acqusition in Brazil was unlikely because the four largest players there have more than 80 percent of the market.
But global players control only around 25 percent of production in Florida, Dreyfus's other main base of operations, offering the possibility of consolidation, they said.
"The smaller competitors, the ones with six to 12 million boxes, will have a hard time competing. We will be looking there for new acquisitions," one said.
Company officials have looked at other areas but found them unattractive, another official said.
"In other parts of the world we have looked at possibilities, in Mexico, but they are just not there," he said.
"There is no reason why we would not go there, but at this point, I don't think Mexico, Morocco or Israel have the scale of operations that we would be interested in."
The company also plans to invest in its own groves so that it can boost its own production in two stages to 10 percent of its needs, officials said.
